question: About Law, you know how, in his crew, there's "Penguin", "Bepo" and "Shachi" (orca)? So, would that make Law a "spotted seal"? I mean, just look at his hat... Please tell me!! am a Walrus
answer: I see (haha). They're all part of the ice-cold sea series, aren't they. I can see what you mean, that hat is kind of like a seal. Well then, it's official. Incidentally, for Mr. Toshio Asakuma's ONE PIECE Animal Figurine Collection, they chose a snow leopard to represent Law. Again, an animal that prefers the cold.
name: I am a Walrus
